classification: Construction-admission calibration and local model-pipeline pilot, not a new RH research row

math_cases.purpose: Replay known local admissibility distinctions before model review; repetitions are implementation fixtures, not independent mathematical discoveries

controls: Composite labels, unadjusted dimension lift, duplicate primitive weights, elliptic quotient collapse and independent-passive factor counterexample. Davenport–Heilbronn is not an instance of these local prime-product objects; no generic completed-function positivity inference tested.

model_pilot.other_gpu_work: Present; existing model queue empty at inspection; no service/model changes

data_handling: Raw model jobs/endpoints stay in ignored local-runs; publish sanitized findings only. Model text is untrusted and never executed. Unknown measurements stay null.
acceptance: Network/schema successes show pipeline function only. Every proposed mathematical claim remains unverified and must undergo source, wall and matched-control review. No automatic research admission, score or thaw.
stop: Bounded pilot ends after its proposal/review phase; invalid output is retained as failure, not automatically retried.
